description: Single storey rear extension, first floor side to rear extension, extension of roof to side to form gable, rear dormer and front roof lights.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan2605 - 012605 - 022605 - 03Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Notwithstanding the details set out in the submitted Preliminary Drainage Strategy, 11th February 2026, prior to the commencement of any construction work, details of the Sustainable Drainage Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:-	Results of infiltration testing to determine the applicability of full and partial infiltration. If infiltration is not deemed acceptable through infiltration testing an appropriate attenuation feature must be provided in line with the London Plan Drainage Hierarchy -	Final sizes, storage volumes, invert levels, cross-sections and specifications of all SuDS measures including rain gardens, permeable paving, and soakaways -	Management Plan for future maintenanceReason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and Policies 5.12 & 5.13 of the London Plan and the NPPF
